title.narrative: Advancing MIL in Chile and Ecuador to build resilience to disinformation, misinformation and hate speech

description.narrative: Chile and Ecuador face similar challenges in terms of the mainstreaming of MIL into education and policy. This biennium the main focus will be building resilience to disinformation, misinformation and hate speech, targeting policy makers, teachers and youth to strengthen their capacities to navigate the multimedia ecosystem and to advocate for a responsible use and meaningful engagement. In Chile, a situation analysis and a policy brief will be produced to inform policies and mobilize relevant stakeholder to create the national MIL Network and to position school media as a relevant MIL teaching/learning practice. This will also contribute to a the AI Observatory, a regional flagship to better understand the impact of AI in and for education. In Ecuador, support will be provided to the development of the technological platform of online learning resources of the Ministry of Education with a focus on MIL, seeking the greatest territorial and teacher coverage through ICT tools and resources.
